text:
sam: Heads up — we just saw a moderate-severity vuln disclosed in the Koios runtime dependency used by inference-worker. Impact: request deserialization flaw that can cause memory exposure on certain inputs. :rotating_light:

maria: which versions are affected?

sam: Koios v1.2.0 -> v1.2.3. Patch released v1.2.4. CVE link from sec-bot below.

sec-bot: [CVE-2026-XXXXX] https://security.example.com/cves/CVE-2026-XXXXX Koios deserialization bug. Patch: v1.2.4. Recommended: upgrade, rotate any short-lived tokens, and run the detection script.

jordan: Assigning actions: 1) patch dev & staging in 4h 2) schedule prod canary deploy in 12h 3) full prod rollout within 24h unless post-canaary alerts.

sre_taylor: On it — I'll start a canary in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Will pin to v1.2.4 and run smoke + memory checks.

maria: Quick checklist for engineers:
- update dependency to `koios==1.2.4` in runtime/requirements.txt
- rebuild worker image: `./scripts/build-worker.sh --tag koios-1.2.4`
- deploy canary: `kubectl set image deploy/inference-worker inference-worker=registry/redwood/worker:koios-1.2.4 -n prod-canary`
- run detection (below) against canary endpoints

sam: Also: rotate service tokens that are used by external integrations to the inference-worker. Any token less than 90 days old should be rotated as precaution.

devops-bot: Automated note: created incident task INC-2026-451 in Jira and assigned to @sre_taylor, @maria.

maria: Detection script (run against canary):
```
curl -s -X POST https://canary-inference.redwood.ai/v1/predict \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"[EXPLOIT_ATTEMPT]"}' | jq -r .error
```
Look for memory/error traces or non-200 responses. If you see `segfault` or `allocation failed`, stop rollout and escalate.

jordan: If teams can't deploy within the window, fallback policy: route traffic to fallback-model-2 (CPU-only, higher latency) via routing policy for affected routes. Use Console -> Routes -> Edit -> Fallback.

lina: FYI compliance: please add a short note in the internal breach log with what was rotated and when. We need evidence for audits.

sre_taylor: I'm starting the canary now. Patch commands in k8s via helm: `helm upgrade inference-worker ./charts/worker --set image.tag=koios-1.2.4 --namespace prod-canary`

maria: Security followups for eng teams: create PRs to pin koios dependency in repo roots and add a unit test that fails if version < 1.2.4. Tag @security-review.

sam: Timeline recap: dev/staging patch in 4h, canary now, prod canary 12h, full prod 24h. If any canary shows anomalies, rollback to previous image and notify @oncall.

jordan: I'll own verification and postmortem/summary after closure. Expected deliverable: short incident note + CVE tracking entry.

sec-bot: Mitigation checklist posted: https://internal.redwood/sec/koios-mitigation (contains detection script, rotation playbook, and rollback steps)

devops-bot: @here audit log entry created: /ops/audit/2026/koios-vuln-1796003210.log

maria: small extra: add runtime feature gate `KOIOS_SAFE_PARSER=true` to canary env while we validate. Commands: `kubectl set env deploy/inference-worker KOIOS_SAFE_PARSER=true -n prod-canary`

sre_taylor: Canary looks healthy at +15m (no segfaults, memory stable). Proceeding with staged rollout to 10% traffic in us-west.

lina: Thanks all — once tokens rotated, email compliance with list of rotated service principals + Jira ticket.

sam: Great work — please post final closure thread when all done. :thumbsup:
